summary: track_build.py (DockerImages 555b1d6 on phase/032-P4) follows a green build's handoff lines into Argo CD by default: it matches Applications by repo, branch and values file, waits until each is Synced at the commit or later with no sync running and health not Progressing, and reports handoffs that pushed nothing. It stops with exit 4 (missing /work clone, every repo named with its git clone line), 5 (roll failed), 6 (roll deadline, --roll-timeout 600 s) or 7 (not picked up within --pickup-timeout 120 s, or no automated sync). Gate green (52 tests); live read-only checks against #551, ElectronicsInventory #255 and DockerImages #2548 behave as V01/V03/V15 expect.
